baseline: Unchanged all-95 two-confirmation signal detector and confirmation-close counterfactual entry, frozen stop, half at 1.5R, remainder at 3R, stop to entry after TP1, 24h maximum, no invented ladder adds. The strict engine is retired from the active runtime. Historical strict records remain untouched; a separate capture-source ledger feeds the single merged two-confirmation decision engine.
dedup_rule: First observed signal per coin/direction/fixed UTC 5m bucket. Duplicate records retained but no second trade. No outcome-based choice.
coincidence: Final cohort count is descriptive and known only after the 5m bucket closes; at-signal count is separately recorded and causal. Cross-coin signals are correlated, not statistically independent.
regime: Completed BTC H1 only. EMA20 above EMA50 and 24-bar efficiency >=0.30: trending_up; EMA20 below EMA50 and efficiency >=0.30: trending_down; otherwise choppy. Missing/stale/noncontiguous data: unknown. No outcome-derived thresholds.
btc_volatility: Sample standard deviation of the last 24 completed hourly log returns; per-hour, not annualized.
atr: Wilder ATR14 on completed 5m and H1 candles. Never fill missing prior context from data arriving after the signal.
volume: Last completed 5m volume / mean of the 20 preceding completed 5m volumes; current candle excluded from denominator.
funding: Latest public ticker funding estimate observed before signal, stale after 15m. Record rate, next funding time, interval and observation time. Estimated future rate is not a realized charge.
costs: Keep the baseline's fixed 10bp funding reserve. Separate benchmark gross R, entry/exit fill allowance and rounding R, fees R, funding R and net R. Actual account fees/funding/queue are unknown.
limit_rule: Near zone edge (high for long, low for short), post-only hypothetical. If marketable at signal, not filled. Activate next full minute after signal availability to avoid a partly elapsed candle; up to 60s extra delay is a bias. Touch assumes maker fill, never queue validation. Cancel on timeout or frozen-stop invalidation before entry. A fill candle is branched so pre-fill extrema cannot stop/profit a trade.
wide_stop_rule: Distance = max(baseline filled-entry stop distance, 3 * pre-entry 5m ATR14). Stop rounded outward, never narrow. Same USDT gross risk and notional cap; recompute same 1.5R/3R target multiples. No 1h ATR fallback if absent.
quality: Recorder candle gaps/conflicts and restarts censor open paper trades. Filled-in candles are explicitly tagged; not automatically backfilled into causal context. Bound both intraminute extreme orderings plus early TP1-return paths. Bounds assume continuous intraminute prices except observed opening gaps.
hour_blocks: Fixed 4h UTC blocks; also record UTC and Colombo fractional hour per signal. Stop groups: below 0.6%, 0.6%-1%, at least 1%.
filter_lock: No exclusion filters. All rules fixed before new data; prior 95 signals are development-only and are not imported into this cohort. A changed policy hash cannot reopen the same ledger.
holdout: Fixed first-signal timestamp + exactly 70% of 28 days (19d 14h 24m). Membership uses signal receipt UTC time, never signal count. 24h development purge. All outcome-bearing events of holdout signals are suppressed before event-chain logging, public logging and every archive stream until final kill check has completed. Public performance stays locked during collection. Seal at >=28 days AND >=150 fixed five-minute time clusters; if slower, extend collection without moving holdout.
kill: At final release halt each paper variant if its lower-bound final net R <=0 or lower-bound benchmark gross R <0. Any censored final position prevents a success verdict and stops paper research as inconclusive. No exchange settings or orders are controlled.
reports: Report deduplicated signal count and time cluster count separately, with net metrics and original splits; sample warning uses fewer than 30 clusters or fewer than 30 closed fills. Touch and through maker fill rates are reported separately after release. Per-trade price gap is pre-entry evidence, not an outcome.
context_cutoff: All causal context is selected as of the frozen theoretical close entry, not the later signal receipt. A separate receipt-time spread is diagnostic only and cannot be a baseline filter. Historical warmup is explicitly tagged and availability is never backdated.
clock: First accepted signal receipt timestamp, reused across amendment and restarts. Exclusive read-only clock config, hash checked against SQLite immutable meta row. Never reset a cohort.
independence: Count distinct fixed UTC five-minute buckets across all coins for the 150 target; variants do not add signals or clusters. This groups simultaneous exposure but does not prove adjacent clusters are statistically independent.
context_repair: Merge delayed REST warmup into bounded context caches by candle start, preserving first-seen availability. Missing context is explicitly incomplete; missing five-minute ATR or volume ratio excludes only wider-stop, not baseline or limit variants. No retrospective context repair of old signals.
limit_through_rule: Parallel to unchanged limit touch variant: long low <= limit - one tick; short high >= limit + one tick. Same zone limit, timeout, maker fees, stop and exits. Start post-fill path at crossing threshold; no earlier extrema. Still a candle-based fill assumption, not queue validation.
arrival_rule: Parallel arrival baseline uses latest fresh observed ask for long or bid for short at signal receipt, plus unchanged adverse allowance and fee model. Keep original absolute structural stop and recompute identical 1.5R/3R multiples. Log raw price gap and basis points versus confirmation close. Fresh quote absent: not filled. Use only post-entry public trade ticks during the partial entry minute, then unchanged full-minute exit paths. No observed partial-minute ticks: censor. No exchange orders.
migration: Only R1->R2 before holdout is permitted. Keep all prior signals, protocol labels and outcomes unchanged. Existing signals keep their original three variants; never invent arrival prices or new fills for old signals. New signals have five variants. Amendment ID records first eligible new signal.
